steps.result:
Risk Management module displays: 

* splashscreen: "No risk registers created yet. Start by creating your first risk register to manage and track risks at the box level." 
* "Create risk register" button 
* Read more link

"Create new risk register" modale appears with fields:

* Name (required)
* Owner
* Issue Types
* Select Templates

Select Templates has 4 Templates variables:

* Basic 5x5 risk register
* Basic 3x3 risk register
* 5x5 Inherit & Residual risk
* 3x3 Initial and Residual risk framework

At the bottom of the modale located "Create" and "Cancel" buttons.
